title: Recursive list of ripple-carry adder gates
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define a list of gates $A_i$ for each natural number $i$ by $A_0=(	ext{false constant gate},	ext{ true constant gate})$. For each $i$, let $A_{i+1}$ be the concatenation of $A_i$ with the bit block whose three data inputs are $i$, $k+i$, and $2k+i$, whose carry input is $n$ when $i=0$ and $n+2+15j+8$ when $i=j+1$, whose accumulator input is $n+1$ when $i=0$ and $n+2+15j+14$ when $i=j+1$, and whose base index is $n+2+15i$.
